name: peer recall
description: Scoped peer-memory READ tool for non-owner callers. Registers the `peer_recall` native tool, which returns ONLY the current conversation partner's own stored record (memory/peers/<platform>_<id>.md + their own peers_graph edges). The peer identity is derived SERVER-SIDE from ctx.sessionKey and is deliberately absent from the parameter schema, so neither the model nor the user can name a target peer — prompt injection cannot widen the scope because no field accepts it. Exists because dinotrust-enforce correctly denies non-owners `memory_search` (which reaches the whole corpus: owner DMs, _pin_ infra notes, other people's reps), leaving web-chat members with a working WRITE path but no READ path. Registered as a FACTORY, not a static tool object, because only the factory receives the live per-session ctx. Fails CLOSED (returns empty on any parse/read/scope error) — the inverse of dinomem-recall-gate's fail-open, because leaking the wrong person's record is worse than returning nothing. Group/non-direct lanes return empty by construction: a group chat must never dereference to one member's private rep.

workspaceDir.description: Workspace root holding memory/peers. Empty = derive from the runtime-supplied ctx.workspaceDir.

agentFilter.description: Only serve sessionKeys containing this substring (e.g. 'agent:<agentId>'). Empty = all agents. Other agents get no tool at all, not an empty result.

maxChars.description: Max rep characters returned. A rep grows unbounded over months of DMs; this caps context cost.

maxEdges.description: Max peers_graph edges returned for the scoped peer subject.

allowSections.description: Rep sections safe to return to the peer themselves. LEDGER and PROVENANCE are deliberately excluded: they carry operator-side bookkeeping about how the rep was derived (our pipeline), not facts about the person.
